description:
Source documentation and test metadata for gf2-coding's standards conformance state facts that disagree with the code and the passing tests.

## Background

Found while writing `docs/reference/standards-conformance.md` (5625a423): the shared test helper `tests/common::dvb_vectors_dir` and the `tests/test_vectors` module default to different vector locations; `dvb_t2_ldpc_verification_suite` is ignored without a reason; the header of `tests/dvb_t2_ldpc_verification.rs` describes completed work as pending; `Nr5gRateMatchedCode` Rustdoc gives the filler LLR as +20 while `FILLER_LLR` is 15; the scope notes in `tests/dvb_t2_bit_interleaver_tp07a.rs` and `src/ldpc/dvb_t2/bit_interleaver.rs` contradict the passing TP07a bit-exact test. The Sionna reference behind the NR base-graph tables has no citation-registry key.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The DVB-T2 vector location has one default, used by every test that reads the vectors.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every ignored DVB-T2 conformance test carries a descriptive ignore reason in the tier vocabulary of `AGENTS.md`.
- [hard] REQ-03: The listed Rustdoc and test comments state current behavior that matches the code and the passing tests.
- [hard] REQ-04: `.jit/references.toml` holds a key for the Sionna reference, and the NR provenance record cites it.
- [hard] REQ-05: The Rust CI gate passes.
title: Correct gf2-coding standards-conformance doc and test drift
